title: Cherry Bekaert
description: cbh.com Revenue $446.7 Million CBH Group Australia's largest grain cooperative, founded in 1933 in Perth and owned by over 3,700 farmer shareholders across Western Australia. It operates the world's largest grain export network with around 200 receival sites, 20 million tons of storage capacity and four export terminals at Kwinana, Albany, Geraldton and Esperance. Each year it handles approximately 20 million tons of grain and exports 15 to 17 million tons, mainly wheat, barley and canola to Asia, the Middle East and beyond. Led by CEO Brendan White, it has invested over 2 billion dollars in infrastructure modernization including rail upgrades, solar energy and digital platforms like the CBH App. The cooperative is financially strong with a BBB credit rating and returns profits to farmers through patronage dividends. It operates its own rail fleet of 360 wagons, runs quality testing laboratories at every site and is expanding port capacity to load Panamax vessels at Kwinana and Albany.
